senses.gloss:
r. 10th cl. (-लाघयति)
1 To taste.
2 To obtain.
(इ) लघि r. 1st cl. (लंघते)
1 To go, to move.
2 To fast, to abstain from food.
(लङ्घति)
1 To dry, to dry up.
2 To diminish, to lessen.
r. 10th cl. (लङ्घयति)
To speak.
With उत् or वि prefixed,
To go beyond or over, to cross, to pass, to leap or spring over; also morally, to exceed, to transgress.

(ऋ) लाघृ r. 1st cl. (लाघते)
To be able or competent.

m. (-ट्)
Air, wind.
E.
लघि to go, अटि Uṇādi aff., and the nasal rejected.

m. (-टिः)
Air, wind.
E.
लघि to go, Uṇādi aff. अटिच्.

m. (-मा)
1 Lightness, absence of weight.
2 Diminutiveness.
3 Insignificance.
E.
लघु light, aff. इमनिच्.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
1 Lightest, very light.
2 Very small, least.
E.
लघु light, इष्ठन् aff. of the irr. superlative.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Lightest, most or very light.
E.
लघु light, and ईयसुन् aff. of the irr. superlative.

mfn. (-घुः-घुः-घ्वी-घु)
1 Light, not heavy.
2 Swift, quick.
3 Sapless, pithless.
4 Beautiful, pleasing.
5 Small, little.
6 Light, vain, frivolous.
7 Insignificant, mean, low.
8 Weak, feeble.
9 Clean, pure.
10 Short, (as a vowel.)
n. adv. (-घु)
Quickly, swiftly.
subst. (-घु)
1 A black kind of Aloe wood or Agallochum.
2 The root of the Andropogon muricatum.
f. (-घुः)
A plant, (Trigonella corniculata.)
f. (-घ्वी)
1 A slight or delicate woman.
2 A small light carriage.
E.
लघि to go, Uṇādi aff. कु, and the nasal not inserted.

m. (-यः)
A goat.
E.
लघु small, and काय a body.

f. (-का)
A small bedstead.
E.
लघु small, खद्विका a bedstead.

m. (-र्गः)
A kind of fish, probably a variety of the Pimelodus.
E.
लघु small, and गर्ग for गर्गर a fish.

mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः)
Low-minded, frivolous.
E.
लघु, and चेतस् mind.

m. (-लः)
A sort of quail.
E.
लघु light, जङ्गल flesh.

f. (-ता)
1 Lightness.
2 Meanness, insignificance.
E.
तल added to लघु; also with त्व, लघुत्वं.

m. (-भिः)
A small kettle-drum.
E.
लघु light, small, and दुन्दुभि a drum.

m. (-कः)
A plant, commonly Śuṇḍārocanī, (Crinum?)
E.
लघु light, small, and पत्रक a leaf.

mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं)
Indolent, impotent.
E.
लघु, and प्रयत्न effort.

m. (-सः)
The francoline partridge.
E.
लघु light, (of digestion,) and मांस flesh.

n. (-त्रं)
A friend or ally of little power or value.
E.
लघु, and मित्र a friend.

n. (-यं)
The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum).
E.
लघु light, लय contexture (in Tatties, &c.) or लघु and लय, both meaning the same root.

mfn. (-साः-साः-सः)
1 Thinly or lightly dressed.
2 Wearing clean or pure clothing.
E.
लघु, and वासस् vesture.

mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति)
1 Low, vile.
2 Ill done, mismanaged.
E.
लघु, and वृत्ति practice.

f. (-ता)
1 Insignificance, meanness.
2 Mismanagement, bad conduct.
E.
तल् added to the last.

n. (-लं)
In algebra, the least root with reference to the additive quantities.
E.
लघु, and मूल root.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Ready or light-handed.
m. (-स्तः)
A good archer.
E.
लघु quick, and हस्त hand.

n. (-णं)
1 Reducing in weight or consequence.
2 Thinking little of, contemning.
E.
लघु, and करण making, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Made light, reduced in weight.
2 Reduced in consequence, made insignificant.
3 Thought lightly of.
E.
लघु, and कृत made, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Eating little, moderate.
E.
लघु, and अशिन् who eats.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Temperate, abstemious.
E.
लघु, and आहार food.

n. (-वं)
1 Health.
2 Lightness, delicacy, minuteness.
3 Meanness, insignificance.
4 Frivolity.
E.
लघु light, &c., and अण् aff.
